plan.accounting: Integer nanodollars; persist before dispatch; no refunds; missing usage retains full reservation
plan.billing_limit: Byte-based admission estimate is not certified tokenizer/billing data; no account-wide or invoice guarantee
plan.request_slots: 1 triage + up to 4*(planning + assessment) + 1 root cause + 1 remediation proposal
plan.mcp_calls: 1 bootstrap incident read + up to 4 model-selected read-only diagnostics
plan.stop: Any non-200 response, invalid/incomplete output/citations, transport error, quota/access denial, budget/deadline, ledger failure
success: Supported final diagnosis: existing gates, evidence review and private grader pass
Correct evidence-based abstention: explicit model abstain, no failure, no proposal, independent review confirms genuinely insufficient/contradictory evidence
plan.not_success: Incomplete, budget exhaustion, transport/HTTP/schema/citation failure; safe abstention on sufficient answerable evidence is not successful diagnosis
plan.outputs: Plan, pre-dispatch ledger, validated decisions, final state/evidence, private grade, fixture/effect checks, review-required outcome

known_test_limit: Existing slow-drip deadline timing failure passed unchanged rerun and final full selection; timing cause unresolved
guard_properties: No refunds for low or missing reported usage
Atomic ledger replacement before dispatch; abort on persistence failure
Single in-flight request; existing ledger cannot reset
Reported overage stops future calls but cannot undo an already reported charge
success_requires: Supported final diagnosis or independently confirmed correct evidence-based abstention; no incomplete result success
